Reviewed committed bytes only at **`c9d3c7cba0e5f5d60e6c2ff0535ae98a4832c8fc`**. Two P2 findings prevent unconditional closure.

1. **P2 — Saved/executed binary is not bound to the qualified compiler output.**  
   [exact-route-receipts.mjs:36](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-c676220d/scripts/exact-route-receipts.mjs:36) checks `capture-binary` against `receipt.binary.sha256`; [line 57](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-c676220d/scripts/exact-route-receipts.mjs:57) checks its reported path. Neither requires that digest to equal `files[example.executable]`, although terminal compiler output hashes are now available.

   The runner also copies the binary but executes the original shared-target path at [exact-route-run.mjs:107](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-c676220d/scripts/exact-route-run.mjs:107) and [line 113](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-c676220d/scripts/exact-route-run.mjs:113). Replacement after compilation could therefore separate captured behavior from the qualified artifact. Bind the saved executable to that compiler hash and execute the verified copy. Add an executable fixture negative replacing the saved binary and rebinding its receipt hash while leaving compiler evidence unchanged. This is a retained gap, not a demonstrated r3 regression.

2. **P2 — The pinned cumulative A/B is structurally refused for intended workspace changes.**  
   [exact-route-units.mjs:127](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-c676220d/scripts/exact-route-units.mjs:127) requires identical unit cohorts; [line 139](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-c676220d/scripts/exact-route-units.mjs:139) requires identical dependency links. Compared with premigration source **`772522f9df7a06d5287c1e9934055206fd464866`**, this candidate adds the unconditional imported-geometry dependency at [rust/geometry/Cargo.toml:77](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-c676220d/rust/geometry/Cargo.toml:77) and geometry-runtime dependency at [rust/processing/Cargo.toml:56](/home/louistrue/.t3/worktrees/ifc-lite/t3-c676220d/rust/processing/Cargo.toml:56).

   Thus equal outputs and unchanged external policies cannot qualify that comparison. The documented “unpaired cohort” hold concretely applies here. Reconcile these intentional workspace graph changes explicitly, retaining provenance for every reached unit. Cover accepted workspace changes and rejected external policy drift with executable paired fixtures.

The earlier example-only policy gap is otherwise addressed statically: every reported compiler artifact is validated, critical workspace crates are required, and paired profiles/features/arguments/link owners are compared. Workspace source digests may differ intentionally; external source digests must match. Every `fresh:true` artifact explicitly refuses. Existing paired dependency-policy negatives exercise comparator behavior rather than source text.

I independently verified all **18 harness hashes, nine fixture hashes and sizes, aggregate harness hash, linked artifacts, original/prior manifest pins, and retained TAP hash**. The correction patch exactly matches its committed source diff; the overlay reconstructs both Rust files exactly. Earlier evidence remains unchanged. Git/fleet and capture-schema protections remain present.

**Static scope only.** I ran no tests, builds, Cargo, A/B, or GitHub operations. The retained 117-pass TAP is synthetic protocol evidence. Real host/build-script/proc-macro handling remains unproven—the fixtures model libraries and an example only, and the wrapper requires every `--extern` to have a file path. Baseline compilation, actual ordered-output A/B, cached-policy qualification, nonempty instancing, federation, all consumers/platforms, and performance remain unproven.
